environment.corpus: the same 13306-file QF_LIA staging; 60-second per-instance timeout

results.headline: 13306 files. base 9038, fix 9058, delta +20 (62 gained, 42 lost). 0 wrong answers, 0 answer disagreements. da3cc0b was -44; switching the rule off entirely was -24; the shape guard is +20, a swing of 64 solves from the measurement that opened this investigation.
results.by_family: nec-smt +15 (44 gained, 29 lost) against -50 at da3cc0b and +8 with the rule off. 20210219-Dartagnan +6, exactly its da3cc0b value, against -29 with the rule off. convert +6, RWS +1, bofill-scheduling and tropical-matrix level. Remaining losses: rings -5, 2019-cmodelsdiff -1, arctic-matrix -1, fft -1.
results.runtime: Paired geometric mean head/base on files both solve with base >= 1s: 0.9874 overall, 0.9847 on nec-smt, 0.9890 elsewhere. No family is above 1. At da3cc0b nec-smt was 1.1023 and at the rule-off default the rest of the corpus was 1.0794; both regressions are gone.
results.prediction: Stated before the run: overall at parity or better, nec-smt keeping its +8, Dartagnan returning to +6. Actual: +20, +15, +6.
results.fuzz_qf_uflra_and_boolean: 132627 and 132628 COMPLETED clean, every sat model Dolmen-validated.
results.fuzz_qf_uflia: 3000 answer cases: 2999 PASS and 1 UNKNOWN_INVOLVED, 0 wrong. 21 invalid models. 20 of the 21 are equally invalid on the 7ea99a7 binary, and that binary also reproduces the recorded witness of bugs/qf-uflia-nested-application-model, so these are the known OPEN bug rather than a regression. The 21st is recorded as a second witness there: it is invalid under every preprocessing mode and under --no-ite-equality-distribution, and valid under --no-extended-simplification, because the leaf's collapse of (ite c t t) changes which model gets built.
results.generator_and_harness_defects: The first QF_UFLIA gate run (132626) was red for two reasons that were not the solver. compose_int_terms emitted (* 2 (* 2 (+ x (- 1)))), scaling a composite term, which QF_UFLIA's :extensions does not admit; checked against Dolmen directly, (* 2 x), (* x 2), (* (- 2) x) and (* x (- 2)) are all accepted and only compound operands are not, and 400 regenerated cases now pass. And the validator reported a Dolmen input rejection as model-error, because its fallback only extracts Real assignments and never runs on an Int logic; it now re-runs Dolmen on the problem alone and reports input-nonconforming outside the failure count.

entries.notes: The three defaults measured end to end on one corpus: distribution unguarded -44, off -24, guarded +20. The rule is sound in all three; what changes is whether it fires where it collects anything. Also worth keeping: base solved 9038 here and 9040 in 132306 on the same binary and corpus, so same-binary churn is about 3 solves, which is the noise floor a three-seed base-against-base campaign was planned to measure and is two orders below the 79 that were attributed to it.

entries.scope: Closes bugs/qf-uflia-nested-application-model, open since 2026-09-04: Primo answered sat and printed a UF table that did not satisfy the input. Root cause established, two candidate fixes measured and one refuted, then fixed.

environment.host: CIIRC SLURM cluster for the gates; local workstation for the 750-case A/B and the witness work
environment.solver: Primo 0.1.0 at 76e5e37; Release; CaDiCaL cadical-3.0.0-7b99c07

results.headline: QF_UFLIA model fuzz gate, 3000 cases, seed base 202609100: 0 model errors, against 21 on the same seeds before the fix. 1535 satisfiable models all validated by Dolmen directly with no Z3 fallback. Answers unchanged at 2999 PASS plus the same single pre-existing unknown case earlier runs also reported. QF_UFLRA (132989) COMPLETED clean.
results.root_cause: The model printer invents an Int value when neither the component model nor the term's congruence class supplies one, via fresh_int_value handing out 0,1,2..., and that number becomes both a table key and, one level up, a result. Inventing is sound for an unconstrained term and unsound for a constrained one, and the builder cannot tell -- it never sees the assertions. Instrumented on witness.smt2: three values invented, all three for f applications, and they are exactly what makes the printed table self-inconsistent.
results.literature: The construction was in the repository's own paper collection. Griggio's thesis sect. 1.5.1 (docs/papers/griggio.pdf p. 30): purification labels every alien subterm with a fresh variable and asserts the label, so in the purified formula every arithmetic-sorted UF application f(v_1..v_n) has a label of its own and all of them are interface variables the arithmetic solver assigns. The row is (val(v_1)..val(v_n)) -> val(v_f), read off rather than searched for, and no value can be missing. docs/papers/griggio-mathsat-thesis.md had skipped the combination background entirely; it now carries it.
results.fix_1: e2058f1: MixedPurificationRewriteState::proxy_by_app already existed and was discarded at the return, since MixedTheoryPurificationResult carried only counts. It is now returned and appended to the model conversion chain as PurificationProxyConversion, so qf_uflia_int_values seeds each application's value from its label. 21 errors to 2.
results.fix_2: 76e5e37: the two survivors were a different mechanism. A user constant is neither an EUF atom member (x = f(...) is an Int equality that goes to LIA) nor an LIA variable (the tableau's nine variables were all internal $primo_ symbols), so it reaches the model only through substitution facts. The value pass read only LiaSubstitutionConversion while the chain ran through a DirectedEqualitySubstitutionConversion, and applied substitutions to model_terms only. With both fixed the sum was still unvalued: evaluate memoizes failures as well as successes and terms are visited in arena order, so x (term 22) was evaluated before $primo_ite_0 (term 33) and the failure was cached permanently. The pass now runs in rounds discarding only failed entries. 2 to 0.
results.refuted_attempt: A bottom-up 'consistent completion' keyed by argument tuple rather than congruence class fixes two of the witnesses and regresses the corpus: same 750 cases, same seed, 8 model errors unchanged against 14 with the pass, and 43 against 21 over 3000 in a two-sweep variant. Forcing an application onto an existing row equates two applications whenever their printed argument values coincide, and those values are partly invented, so a collision merges applications the solver kept apart. Reverted; recorded in the bug file because it looks obviously right.
results.diagnostics_added: :model.invented-int-values. On a correct model of a fully labelled formula it should be zero; it was 8 on case-00130 and is 6 now, the remainder being genuinely unconstrained applications.

entries.notes: Three attempts, and the pattern is worth keeping: the first two tried to repair the consumer -- making the printer self-consistent, then reasoning about backward-propagating constraints -- when the producer was discarding information it already had. The literature pointed straight at it. Also fixed on the way: the QF_UFLIA generator emitted (* 2 (* 2 ...)), which QF_UFLIA's :extensions does not admit, and the model validator reported a Dolmen input rejection as a solver model error because its fallback only extracts Real assignments and never runs on an Int logic.

entries.scope: open-leads lead 16 piece 1, constant if-then-else simplification. The lead's falsifier on nec-smt, then the full QF_LIA division to check the technique does not help one family at another's expense.

environment.solver: Primo 0.1.0 at 008e115 for the falsifier and d8462db for the division check; one binary per run, the two arms differing only by --cite-simplification
environment.corpus: sandbox/non-incremental/QF_LIA; 2780 nec-smt files, then all 13306; 60-second timeout

results.falsifier: nec-smt, 2780 files: off 644, on 1269, +625 with 625 gained and 0 lost, against a promotion bar of +200 stated in the lead before the work. Paired runtime over the 577 files both arms solve with base above a second: geometric mean 0.589, summed -38.5%.
results.full_division: 13306 files: off 9061, on 9660, +599 with 601 gained and 2 lost (one in 2019-cmodelsdiff, one in nec-smt). Zero wrong answers and zero disagreements. By family, only nec-smt moves: +599. Paired runtime geometric mean 0.830 overall, 0.612 on nec-smt with total time -36.1%, and 1.0045 on every other family with total time +0.9% -- so the technique is neutral where it does not apply rather than harmful.
results.correctness_basis: All 2780 nec-smt files carry a declared :status (1524 unsat, 1256 sat) and all 1269 answers the CITE arm produced were checked against it, none contradicting. This is worth stating because the wrong-answer column is inert on corpora without :status, as slurm_qf_lra_scrambled_compare.sbatch documents.
results.cost: The formula grows and preprocessing slows: on nec-smt/large/getoption_directories/prp-4-113.smt2, ite auxiliaries 40284 to 10026, preprocessed size 443762 to 1280886, preprocessing 2.8s to 27s. Solve counts pay for it several times over.
results.piece_2: ITE compression's semantic content was already present through the Boolean-ite rules plus hash-consing: a three-deep (ite c t false) chain compresses fully today. What the thesis adds is selectivity and naming with a fresh propositional variable, and hash-consing already supplies what the naming is for. So the lead's requirement to evaluate pieces 1 and 2 together was met by implementing 1 and ordering it before the rules that already do 2.

entries.notes: Two implementation notes worth keeping. The csimp cache must be keyed on (op, term, constant, side) across the pass, not per atom: getting that wrong cost 183 seconds against 2.8 on one file. And passing the compared constant as a reference into a core::Term is a use-after-free, because every mk_* call can grow the arena; ASan caught it on the first nec-smt file. Piece 3, ITE reconstruction, remains unimplemented and is what is left of lead 16.

entries.scope: Constant if-then-else simplification was promoted on QF_LIA evidence alone, but simplify-constant-ites sits in the unconditional initial sequence and runs for every logic. This measures the other three.

environment.solver: Primo 0.1.0 at d8462db; one binary, the arms differing only by --no-cite-simplification
environment.corpus: sandbox/non-incremental/QF_LRA 1753, QF_UFLRA 1284, tmp/QF_UFLIA 659; 60-second timeout

results.solve_counts: QF_LIA 9061 -> 9660 (+599). QF_LRA 1533 -> 1531 (-2, none gained). QF_UFLRA 1270 -> 1270. QF_UFLIA 571 -> 571. No wrong answers and no disagreements anywhere.
results.runtime: Paired geometric mean on files both arms solve: QF_LRA 1.0136 with total time +1.87% over 476 files, QF_UFLRA 1.0150 with +1.60% over 60. So outside QF_LIA the pass costs a small, systematic amount and returns nothing, which matches the thesis reporting these techniques worth +2 on QF_LRA.
results.verdict: Kept on by default. The -2 on QF_LRA is inside the same-binary churn floor measured earlier on this branch (base scored 9038 and 9040 on identical binary and corpus), so it is not distinguishable from noise; the ~1.7% runtime cost on the Real logics is real but did not cost solves on QF_UFLRA and is bounded by the extended_term_count early-out, which skips the pass entirely on formulas containing no ite. Scoping the default to Int logics remains available if the QF_LRA cost is ever shown to be more than churn.
results.correctness_gates: QF_UFLRA, QF_UF Boolean and finite-domain gates all clean. The QF_UFLIA gate reported 2999 answer PASS with 1 timeout, and 1 model error in 3000 -- reproducible with and without --cite-simplification, so not caused by this change.
results.bug_status_correction: That single model error is the same nested-application shape as bugs/qf-uflia-nested-application-model, which was recorded as FIXED the previous day on the strength of 0 errors in 3000 at seed base 202609100. A different seed base finds one. The bug file now reads LARGELY FIXED, about a 95% reduction from 21, with witness-residual-2026-09-07.smt2 kept: 12 invented Int values against 5 purification labels, so the unvalued terms are again ones no label covers.

entries.notes: The lesson worth keeping is the one that prompted this run: a default was promoted on a single logic's evidence when the pass runs for all of them, and the check took one submission. The same reasoning applies to the fuzz gate: 0 errors in 3000 is a statement about a seed, and a second seed is what turns it into a statement about the code.

entries.scope: solve_qf_uflra_engine_impl carried two near-identical blocks of forced model-equality logic, one under !options.produce_model and one under options.produce_model: the same EUF equality scan, the same real-model separation, the same candidate final-scan fallback. They are extracted into compute_forced_model_equalities(). Behaviour must not change, so the check is preservation of answers and of every non-timing counter, not a solve count.

environment.baseline: main 45a16ad, built in a separate worktree
environment.candidate: qf-uflra-forced-equality-dedup; the only changed source file is src/smt/solver_engines.cpp (+226/-187)
environment.corpus: 15 tracked QF_UFLRA files (regressions and seeds) plus 120 generated QF_UFLRA cases; each corpus run twice, once as written and once with :produce-models true

commands.gates: make check (41/41 CTest, 188 Python), make asan-test (41/41), make lint
commands.generation: the QF_UFLRA case generator, 120 cases, each agreeing with z3

results.preservation: Four comparisons, all with answers match: True and non-time stats match: True. 15 tracked files as written; 15 with :produce-models true (3 sat keep (get-model)); 120 generated cases as written; 120 generated with :produce-models true (76 sat keep (get-model)).
results.coverage: The model-requesting arms are what exercise the options.produce_model half of the extraction; without them the refactored branch is never entered, so the plain runs alone would not have qualified the change.
results.harness_note: A first attempt appended (get-model) without setting :produce-models true. Both binaries then printed the same answer and the same error and exited non-zero, and compare_local_solver_stats.py marks any non-zero run as a disagreement, so all 135 model files reported disagreement while every counter matched. The signature of a harness artefact rather than a regression is exactly that: answers disagree everywhere, counters agree everywhere. Fixed by setting the option and dropping (get-model) from the files that answer unsat.
results.open: The cluster run is SLURM array 146259 over the 1,284-file QF_UFLRA corpus at primo-cadical-profile/tmp/QF_UFLRA, baseline main 45a16ad (sha256 2eb0fc2d) against candidate 3f5bf21 (sha256 d9119cfc), 16 tasks all COMPLETED at a 30-second timeout. Every non-timing counter matches on all 1,284 files. 1,266 also match on answers. The other 18 are large cpachecker-bmc and cpachecker-induction files on which BOTH binaries time out at 30 seconds with no answer; compare_local_solver_stats.py requires status ok on every run, so it records a mutual timeout as a disagreement. Their counters match even in that state. Job 146275 rechecks those 18 at a 300-second timeout.

entries.notes: The duplication was flagged as mixed-model-equality-dedup and survived the earlier move into solver_engines.cpp. The two callers keep their own diagnostic wording and their own :no.interface.arrangement-failures increments, and the arrangement caller deduplicates a complete precomputed LRA list where the model caller copies plainly, which is why the helper takes a complete_source flag rather than assuming one shape.
